    static class MinCostFlow {

        private final int src, dst;
        private final long[] phi;
        private final long[] dist;
        private final int[] prev;
        private final int n;
        private final int[] visited;

            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;

            dist = new long[n];

            q[tail++] = src;
            inQ[src] = true;
            int steps = 0, maxSteps = 2 * n * n;
            while (head != tail) {
                int u = q[head++];
                if (head == n) head = 0;
                inQ[u] = false;

                    int v = g.destination(e);

                            inQ[v] = true;
                            if (tail == n) tail = 0;
                        }

                }
                if (++steps > maxSteps) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative cycle");

        }

            long cost = 0, flow = 0;
            while (maxF > 0) {
                dijkstra();
                if (prev[dst] == -1) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (dist[i] != Long.MAX_VALUE) phi[i] += dist[i];
                }
                long f = maxF;

                    f = Math.min(f, g.capacity(prev[v]));
                }
                maxF -= f;
                long c = 0;
                for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g.source(prev[v])) {
                    c += g.weight(prev[v]);
                }
                cost += c * f;
                flow += f;
                for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g.source(prev[v])) {
                    g.pushFlow(prev[v], f);
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(cost, flow);
        }

            Arrays.fill(prev, -1);

                heap.add(src);
                while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = heap.poll();

                        if (g.capacity(e) == 0) continue;
                        int v = g.destination(e);
                        long nd = dist[u] + g.weight(e) - phi[v] + phi[u];

                            dist[v] = nd;
                            if (heap.getIndex(v) == -1) heap.add(v);

                            prev[v] = e;

    static class Heap {
        private int[] heap;
        private int[] pos;
        private int size;
        private IntComparator cmp;

        public Heap(int maxVal, IntComparator cmp, int cap) {
            this.cmp = cmp;
            heap = new int[cap];
            pos = new int[maxVal];
            Arrays.fill(pos, -1);

        public boolean isEmpty() { return size == 0; }

        public void add(int x) {
            heap[size] = x;
            pos[x] = size;
            shiftUp(size++);
        }

        public void shiftUp(int i) {
            while (i > 0) {
                int p = (i - 1) >>> 1;
                if (cmp.compare(heap[p], heap[i]) <= 0) break;
                swap(i, p);
                i = p;
            }
        }

        public int poll() {
            int x = heap[0];
            pos[x] = -1;
            if (--size > 0) {
                heap[0] = heap[size];
                pos[heap[0]] = 0;
                shiftDown(0);
            }
            return x;
        }

        private void shiftDown(int i) {
            while (true) {
                int l = (i << 1) + 1;
                if (l >= size) break;
                if (l + 1 < size && cmp.compare(heap[l], heap[l + 1]) > 0) l++;

                swap(i, l);
                i = l;

        private void swap(int i, int j) {
            int t = heap[i]; heap[i] = heap[j]; heap[j] = t;
            pos[heap[i]] = i; pos[heap[j]] = j;
        }

        public int getIndex(int x) { return pos[x]; }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public final U first;
        public final V second;
        public Pair(U f, V s) { first = f; second = s; }
        public static <U, V> Pair<U, V> makePair(U f, V s) { return new Pair<>(f, s); }
    }

    interface IntComparator {
        int compare(int a, int b);
    }
}

        public MinCostFlow(Graph g, int src, int dst, boolean hasNeg) {
            this.g = g;
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            n = g.vertexCount;
            phi = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            prev = new int[n];
            if (hasNeg) fordBellman();
            if (g.isSparse()) {

        private void fordBellman() {
            Arrays.fill(phi, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            phi[src] = 0;
            boolean[] inQ = new boolean[n];
            int[] q = new int[n + 1];
            int head = 0, tail = 0;
            q[tail++] = src;
            inQ[src] = true;
            int steps = 0, maxSteps = 2 * n * n;
            while (head != tail) {
                int u = q[head++];
                if (head == n) head = 0;
                inQ[u] = false;
                for (int e = g.firstOutbound(u); e != -1; e = g.nextOutbound(e)) {
                    if (g.capacity(e) == 0) continue;
                    int v = g.destination(e);
                    long nd = phi[u] + g.weight(e);
                    if (phi[v] > nd) {
                        phi[v] = nd;
                        if (!inQ[v]) {
                            q[tail++] = v;
                            inQ[v] = true;
                            if (tail == n) tail = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (++steps > maxSteps) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative cycle");
            }
        }

        public static Pair<Long, Long> minCostMaxFlow(Graph g, int s, int d, boolean hasNeg, long maxF) {
            return new MinCostFlow(g, s, d, hasNeg).run(maxF);

        private Pair<Long, Long> run(long maxF) {
            long cost = 0, flow = 0;

                if (prev[dst] == -1) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                long f = maxF;
                for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g.source(prev[v])) {
                    f = Math.min(f, g.capacity(prev[v]));

                maxF -= f;
                long c = 0;
                for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g.source(prev[v])) {
                    c += g.weight(prev[v]);
                }
                cost += c * f;
                flow += f;
                for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g.source(prev[v])) {
                    g.pushFlow(prev[v], f);
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(cost, flow);
        }

        private void dijkstra() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(prev, -1);
            dist[src] = 0;
            if (visited == null) {

                        int v = g.destination(e);

                    visited[u] = visitIdx;
                    for (int e = g.firstOutbound(u); e != -1; e = g.nextOutbound(e)) {

                        int v = g.destination(e);
                        if (visited[v] != visitIdx) {

                            if (dist[v] > nd) {
                                dist[v] = nd;
                                prev[v] = e;
                            }

                    }
                }
                visitIdx++;
            }
        }
    }

    static class Heap {
        private int[] heap;
        private int[] pos;
        private int size;
        private IntComparator cmp;

        public Heap(int maxVal, IntComparator cmp, int cap) {
            this.cmp = cmp;
            heap = new int[cap];
            pos = new int[maxVal];
            Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
        }

        public boolean isEmpty() { return size == 0; }

        public void add(int x) {
            heap[size] = x;
            pos[x] = size;
            shiftUp(size++);
        }

        public void shiftUp(int i) {
            while (i > 0) {
                int p = (i - 1) >>> 1;
                if (cmp.compare(heap[p], heap[i]) <= 0) break;
                swap(i, p);
                i = p;
            }
        }

        public int poll() {
            int x = heap[0];
            pos[x] = -1;
            if (--size > 0) {
                heap[0] = heap[size];
                pos[heap[0]] = 0;
                shiftDown(0);
            }
            return x;
        }

        private void shiftDown(int i) {
            while (true) {
                int l = (i << 1) + 1;
                if (l >= size) break;
                if (l + 1 < size && cmp.compare(heap[l], heap[l + 1]) > 0) l++;
                if (cmp.compare(heap[i], heap[l]) <= 0) break;
                swap(i, l);
                i = l;
            }
        }

        private void swap(int i, int j) {
            int t = heap[i]; heap[i] = heap[j]; heap[j] = t;
            pos[heap[i]] = i; pos[heap[j]] = j;
        }

        public int getIndex(int x) { return pos[x]; }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public final U first;
        public final V second;
        public Pair(U f, V s) { first = f; second = s; }
        public static <U, V> Pair<U, V> makePair(U f, V s) { return new Pair<>(f, s); }
    }

    interface IntComparator {
        int compare(int a, int b);
    }
